newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVENERGO VALUATION TO BE PRESENTED JULY 7.
newsitem.headline: LATVENERGO VALUATION TO BE PRESENTED JULY 7.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) on Wednesday said it will be able to decide on the final version of the Latvenergo sell-off plan after valuation and sell-off study results are received on July 7.
Deloitte & Touche and Deitsche Bank are carrying out the valuation of the monopoly electricity firm and analyses of investment strategies.

"On July 7 we will meet Deloitte & Touche and Deutsche Bank on valuation results as well as an investment programme, environmental issue analyses and sell-off proposals," Janis Naglis, LPA general manager, told a news conference.
"We could then proceed with choosing the privatisation plan," Naglis said.
The agency has already unveiled sell-off guidelines which foresee Latvenergo to be turned into a holding company by the end of this year with four competing daughter companies on the generation side.
The LPA wants to have the power generators privatised at least partially by the end of the year.
It earlier said it would draw the final privatisation plan after the state electricity regulatory body has made its recomendations on competition.
